name: 30060 · Marietta, GA
findings: ZIP 30060 (Marietta) has 177 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 71 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30060 (Marietta) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 30060 (Marietta) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 71 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.
